subject: Vendor portal evidence merge & delegated uploader clarification
messages:
From: Jake Miller <jmiller@brightleaf.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@brightleaf.com
Date: Thu, 5 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendr onboarding: merging evidence streams and uploader roles

Hi Grace,

Thanks again for taking time during the call today. Two quick asks from our side as we prepare the onboarding bundle for Brightleaf:

1) We currently have evidence in two streams: our internal SOC2 bucket and a separate PCI evidence repo. Vendr suggested we can submit them as a single manifest but also keep provenance. Is that approach okay from Redwood's intake perspective? Any naming conventions we should follow when we upload a merged CSV manifest?

2) We use a delegated uploader (third-party SI) that will push files on our behalf. They will appear under an SFTP service account. I want to confirm whether Redwood needs to see the delegated account mapped to a named contact or if a service account identifier is sufficient for portal delegation.

I attached the current onboarding manifest (brightleaf_onboarding_manifest.csv) for context — it's a pretty small set right now.

Appreciate a quick confirmation so we can schedule the bulk upload window.

Thanks,
Jake
Jake Miller
Head of Security Operations
Brightleaf Payments
(attachment: brightleaf_onboarding_manifest.csv)

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Jake Miller <jmiller@brightleaf.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 5 Jun 2025 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendr onboarding: merging evidence streams and uploader roles

Jake — thanks for the manifest and clear summary. Short answers up front, then a couple of operational notes:  

- Merged manifest: yes, that's fine. We prefer a single manifest file for portal ingest but require a provenance column (source_bucket / origin_path) for each row so we can map ownership back to the original store. Naming: please include company and date in the filename (e.g., brightleaf_manifest_20250605.csv).

- Delegated uploader: a service account identifier is sufficient for onboarding. However, for auditability we need a delegation matrix spreadsheet that maps service account -> vendor company -> technical contact. That can be a separate Excel file (redwood_delegation_matrix.xlsx).

Operational notes: 
- For bulk ingest with Vendr, schedule a 2-hour window during off-peak (we typically use 02:00-04:00 UTC).
- Include checksums (SHA256) in the manifest for large artifacts where possible.

Ben / Karthik — can you confirm our desired manifest column set and whether the ingestion pipeline will accept mixed-origin (SOC2 + PCI) evidence in one pass if provenance is present?

Best,
Grace
Sr. CS Ops Manager
Redwood Inference

(Attachment: brightleaf_onboarding_manifest.csv referenced)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 5 Jun 2025 12:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendr onboarding: merging evidence streams and uploader roles

Grace — quick confirm: our Vendr pipeline accepts mixed-origin evidence in a single ingest so long as provenance columns are present (source_bucket, original_path, evidence_type). We run lightweight validation that flags PCI/TLS/more-sensitive artifacts for manual review but it won't stop the ingest. Required manifest columns we enforce: filename, sha256, file_size_bytes, evidence_type, source_bucket, original_path, submitted_by.

If Brightleaf can include those columns (or a superset), the upload will proceed and flagged items will be queued for triage in the portal.

Karthik — looping you on the delegated uploader ask: for audit/logging we need the delegation_matrix mapping Grace mentioned. Anything else for SOC 2 traceability?

—Ben
Head of Solutions (Security Onboarding)
Redwood Inference

(attachment: redwood_manifest_template.csv)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Jake Miller <jmiller@brightleaf.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 7 Jun 2025 15:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendr onboarding: merging evidence streams and uploader roles

Hi Jake — thanks for the quick turnaround on the manifest. A few final items before we lock the window: 

1) Please rename the manifest to include the date and add the columns Ben outlined. I've attached a small starter workbook (redwood_delegation_matrix.xlsx) for you to populate with service-account IDs and contacts.

2) For PCI-scoped evidence we will flag items that require restricted storage. If any of your rows are PCI, mark evidence_type=PCI and we will extract them to a controlled bucket post-ingest. That extraction won't hold up the rest of the manifest.

3) Delegation: the service account identifier is acceptable in portal metadata, but for SOC 2 traceability we need a signed delegation attestation from your vendor (simple statement PDF signed by the vendor security lead). If you can upload that to Vendr during the same window and include its filename in the manifest, we'll attach it to the audit trail.

Proposed next steps: you drop the updated manifest + delegation matrix in the Vendr staging folder by Mon 09 Jun 02:00 UTC; we schedule ingest Mon 09 Jun 03:00 UTC and monitor the triage queue. If anything is handoff-only (PCI restricted), we'll ping your team in the portal.

Jake — can you confirm the drop date/time?

Thanks,
Karthik
Principal Security Engineer
Redwood Inference

(Attachments: redwood_delegation_matrix.xlsx)
